story.title: The Little Flower
story.setting: A sunny backyard garden with green lawn, flower beds and a wooden bench, soft natural afternoon light, realistic cinematic look.

subjects.words: a young woman with shoulder-length dark curly hair in a grey knit sweater
a middle-aged man with short grey hair and grey stubble in a grey t-shirt

beats.text: The woman kneels by the empty flowerpot and looks at it sadly.
The man walks up behind her, taps her shoulder and brings a small flowering plant out from behind his back; she turns and her face lights up.
They kneel together and plant the little flower in the pot, then look at each other and smile.
